## Source coverage — What source data is needed for the rows to report? {#source-coverage-what-source-data-is-needed-for-the-rows-to-report}

Use the database-import review to establish which records and associations must be supplied.

For each ROS sheet, identify the source fields, references and any additional ObServe sheets needed.

Record the details in its sheet review before deciding whether the intermediate model is sufficient.

If a row is required, resolve its mandatory data and any permitted missing-data representation explicitly.

## Review mappings before implementation

Review each ROS sheet in its own document. Use the same structure for every review:

* What one output row represents and which keys identify it.
* Source tables, fields and reference records.
* Joins, lookups, calculations and missing information.
* Philippe's relevant SQL and R code, with source locations.
* Decisions required before implementation and their effect on the intermediate model.

Philippe's code is evidence to examine, not the extraction architecture to reproduce.

Trip selection is already a separate stage in our design; his query filters do not define our export scope.

### LL sheet reviews

* [O-INFO mapping](ll-01-o-info.html): observer identity, embarkation, disembarkation and trip summaries.
